mapper.sql: S.STOCK_ID, S.DEPARTMENT_ID, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, S.ITEM_ID, I.NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.CATEGORY, I.UNIT, I.RETURNABLE, S.TOTAL_QTY, S.AVAILABLE_QTY, S.STATUS, S.UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID, NAME, CATEGORY, UNIT, RETURNABLE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT FROM SF_RESOURCE_ITEM ORDER BY ITEM_ID
SELECT FROM SF_RESOURCE_STOCK S JOIN SF_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = S.DEPARTMENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID WHERE S.STOCK_ID = #{stockId}

SELECT LOG_ID, STOCK_ID, ACTION, TOTAL_BEFORE, TOTAL_AFTER, AVAILABLE_BEFORE, AVAILABLE_AFTER, REQUEST_ID, REASON, CHANGED_BY, CHANGED_BY_NAME, CHANGED_AT FROM ( SELECT L.LOG_ID, L.STOCK_ID, L.ACTION, L.TOTAL_BEFORE, L.TOTAL_AFTER, L.AVAILABLE_BEFORE, L.AVAILABLE_AFTER, L.REQUEST_ID, L.REASON, L.CHANGED_BY, M.NAME AS CHANGED_BY_NAME, L.CHANGED_AT FROM SF_RESOURCE_STOCK_LOG L JOIN SF_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = L.CHANGED_BY WHERE L.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} ORDER BY L.LOG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
